title: "No bass in my monitor"
intro: Each wedge has its own mix on the mixer. Pick that mix with the buttons above the faders. In a mix, the faders set how much of each channel goes to that wedge.

complaints.says: I can't hear the bass in my wedge.

win.label: Faders back on Main when you're done
win.hint: Click Main above the faders so the faders control the room again.

hints: Wedge 3 plays Mix 3. Which channels are being sent to Mix 3?
cause: The Bass channel's send to Mix 3 (the keys wedge) was turned all the way down.
lesson: A monitor mix only has what you send to it. Select the mix, then bring that channel's fader up — and remember to go back to Main afterwards.
